# Usual weekly hours by full-time and part-time employment (fixture)

> **FIXTURE — not a real source.** Written for the test suite. The numbers illustrate a structure; they are not evidence about the world.

Weekly hours differ sharply between employment forms. Full-time employees report usual
weekly hours close to the upper end of the standard band, while part-time employees
report roughly half of that. Because the aggregate indicator pools both groups, a change
in the part-time share moves the average without any change in anyone's working week.
Any comparison of average hours should therefore be read together with the distribution
of employment forms.
